periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, tapering towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop or oval shape with vertical height significantly exceeding horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the inferior margin extending substantially below the medial horizontal axis.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape along the posterior boundary with a relatively flat transition across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately one-quarter of the visible longitudinal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Right ear displays a smooth, rounded semicircular apex; left ear is occluded by cranial positioning.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular area of pinkish-red skin exposure (likely alopecia or a lesion) on the lower back and hindquarters; several small dark punctate marks are visible within the white fur on the upper rump.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced thinning of white guard hairs across the dorsal-posterior region revealing underlying pink tissue.
